column1: DB: update/insert new special prices for customer's
column47:
*Why:* According to instant payment regulation we have to ensure that instant SEPA payment does not cost more than normal SEPA payment. To make price management simpler instead of having separate prices for SEPA instant, SEPA domestic and SEPA crossborder - one price for all SEPA payments will be introduced.
*When:* To be decided
*Where:* LT, LV, EE, crebit.ps_price
*What:*

*Outgoing payments:*
 * Check only prices on customer or on customer account (special prices). Bundles, price list and other prices to be left unchanged (shall be changed manually).
 * Insert new price 'EU_OUT'
 * Update VALID_UNTIL_DATE for prices ''FPO_EU_OUT',  'IDP_OUT', 'DPO_OUT_LOG_IN', 'DPO_OUT_LOG_OUT', 'IDP_EU_OUT', 'DPO_OUT'

 

Calculation rules for parameters of new price 'EU_OUT':
 # If only one of old prices is defined for customer or account - copy all parameters from it to new price.
 # If more than one price is defined:
 ## Exclude 'DPO_OUT_LOG_IN', 'DPO_OUT_LOG_OUT' from calculations what price to use.
 ## Ignore values STORE_FOC_TRANSACTIONS, DESCRIPTION, CURRENCY_CODE_OPER
 ## The other logic is in the diagram

 

!image-2024-10-31-14-21-05-622.png|width=1160,height=343!

 

When creating new prices:
 * CURRENCY_CODE_OPER should be EUR
 * VALID_UNTIL_DATE should be the longest one from old ones
 * VALID_FROM_DATE should be{color:#de350b} {color:#172b4d}2024-12-01{color}{color}
 *  

*Incoming payments:*
 * Check only prices on customer or on customer account (special prices). Bundles, price list and other prices to be left unchanged (shall be changed manually).
 * Insert new price 'EU_IN' (in LT only)
 * Update VALID_UNTIL_DATE for prices 'IDP_IN', 'FPO_EU_IN'

LT:
 * If only one of these prices is defined for customer or account - copy all parameters from it to new price.

LV, EE:
 * If customer has 'EU_IN' and any or both 'IDP_IN', 'FPO_EU_IN' - only add VALID_UNTIL_DATE for prices 'IDP_IN', 'FPO_EU_IN'
 * If customer does not have 'EU_IN' but has any or both 'IDP_IN', 'FPO_EU_IN' - insert new price for customer with parameters from existing price. Add VALID_UNTIL_DATE for old prices

 

*Possible impacts (changes could impact other applications/ processes etc.):* pricing engine?
*Acceptance criteria/ testing notes:* Text

column1: [DB] E-invoices: Abstract invoice automated payment creation works incorrect way
column47:
*Issue:* Abstract invoice automated payment creation works incorrect way

*Preconditions:*

SOA was concluded for abstract e-invoice to particular Seller. Later this Seller concluded Seller agreement and imported e-invoice related with newly concluded Seller agreement.

*Steps to reproduce:*
 # Created SOA for abstract e-invoice;
 # For the same Seller concluded Seller agreement;
 # Imported e-invoice related with newly concluded Seller agreement. 
 # Run batch einvoices.batch.generate_automated_paym_docs.

*Expected results:* e-invoice automated payment agreement is linked with e-invoice, e-invoice automated payment is created.

*Actual results:* E-invoice automated payment agreement is not linked and automated payment is not created. E-invoice is in manual payable list.

+Note:+ In all cases listed below e-invoice should be linked with e-invoice automated payment agreement (SOA) and created e-invoice automated payment:

1. SOA concluded to Seller agreement which now is closed. Imported abstract e-invoice with the same Seller.

column1: [ISO Exchange] Incorrect value date for some TIPS camt.054
column47:
*Issue:* For TIPS camt.054 messages received close to end of day (around 23:15)
 * incorrect value_date is saved to payments_iso.debt_cred_notification
 * incorrect value date (vaartuspaev) appears in transaction to vm.korrresp_toiming 

Same behavior is not observed for messages received at earlier times or when same message is uploaded manually during working hours.

*Preconditions:* Camt.054 from TIPS is received close to end of day (around 23:15) having value date greater than current date.

*Steps to reproduce:*
 # Receive camt.054 from TIPS with value date (BkToCstmrDbtCdtNtfctn/Ntfctn/Ntry/ValDt) greater than current date
 # check PAYMENTS_ISO.DEBT_CRED_NOTIFICATION.VALUE_DATE
 # check VM.KORRESP_TOIMING.VAARTUSPAEV (in case there is event message_processed)

*Expected results:*

Value date is stored according to value from XML for both, message and transaction

*Actual results:*

For message received and processed close to end-of-day (e.g. 23:15), value date is set to wrong date (value date from xml + 1).
 * See msg_sid 777377 in LV
 ** xml: <Dt>2025-01-{*}16Z{*}</Dt
 ** debt_cred_notification.value_date = {*}17{*}.01.2025
!image-2025-01-20-08-53-56-909.png|width=713,height=51!
 ** korresp_toiming.vaartuspaev = {*}17{*}.01.2025:
!image-2025-01-20-09-16-51-278.png|width=711,height=81!
 * Similar situation with msg_sid 778842 in LV.

When similar message is uploaded manually during daytime, the value date is stored correctly. Also there exist messages with future date received at earlier time (e.g 20:30, msg_sid 778819, 777366) that are stored correctly but these specific ones do not have related transaction (event = message_dismissed).

*Impact:*
Part of automated liquidity transfers between TIPS and RT1 are booked with incorrect date, impacting liquidity management and accounting. ILM cannot schedule automated liquidity transfers for that period. These transfers become critical with cross-border instant payments.

*Additional information:*
 * Occurs in production, reported by ILM team
 * Value date in TIPS messages was introduced with EASYPAY-723 RT1: Business date in TIPS camt.054 message - Swedbank

column1: 6. Request a fraud screening response from OFD broker and publish it to FLM
column47:
*Why:* All signed payments need to be screened against fraud.
*When:* 
*Where:* worker-payment-batch-handler
*What:*

Continuation of story EASYPAY-1184
 # Call OFD broker API end point /v2/batch-transactions/\{transaction-id} ([Swagger|http://ofd-broker-api-dev.swedbank.net/swagger-ui/index.html#/]) to get a fraud screening response. Use transaction_id from Kafka topic or from fraud-screening-request/timeout result
 # If there is response from OFD broker, then
 ## for each payment:
 ### Take payment SID from OFD broker (entry_id = transaction_id)
 ### Call API endpoint [payment/get/\{id}|https://core-payment-batch-handler-data-manager-dev.apps.scp-west-zone01-z02.swedbank.io/swagger-ui/index.html#/Payment%20batch%20handler%20data%20manager%20payment/getPaymentDpId] to get dp.id of the payment
 ### Publish to Kafka topic w990.batch.handler.payment.actions (created with EASYPAY-902):
 #### Action - "ANTIFRAUD_SCREENING"
 #### Result - "ACCEPTED" / "REJECTED" - depending on what is provided in response from OFD broker. If UNKNOWN is provided, store to DB as PFS_UNKNOWN, but provide to FLM as "ACCEPTED"
 #### Related_system should contain PBH_ID - payment SID and PBH_HID - batch SID
 #### Add COUNTRY_CODE and ids from related_system to header
 ### Call API end point [payment/update-status|https://core-payment-batch-handler-data-manager-dev.apps.scp-west-zone01-z02.swedbank.io/swagger-ui/index.html#/Payment%20batch%20handler%20data%20manager%20payment/updatePaymentStatus] - update fraud_screening status to either "PFS_ACCEPTED" or "PFS_REJECTED" depending on response from OFD broker
 ## Call API end point [fraud-screening-request/update |https://core-payment-batch-handler-data-manager-dev.apps.scp-west-zone01-z02.swedbank.io/swagger-ui/index.html#/Payment%20batch%20handler%20data%20manager%20fraud%20screening/updateFraudScreening](using sourceTransactionId = fraud screening SID) with data:
 ### Fraud screening SID
 ### {color:#172b4d}response_received_dtime - time when OFD broker API endpoint response was received{color}
 ### response_code - from API call
 ### Status = 'Completed'
 # If there is no response from OFD broker, then do process described in EASYPAY-904

column1: 12. Implement fraud screening recovery process
column47:
*Why:* if sending fraud screening request or requesting fraud screening answer failed, fraud screening recovery process needs to check at which step fraud screening request sending/receiving failed and then proceed accordingly
*When:* 
*Where:* worker-payment-batch-handler
*What:*

As this is recovery process - it has to reuse as many elements of original process, so that no action would be duplicated in the application (easier maintenance later).

 

Process:
 # Read Kafka topic (created with SMARTPAY-850), filter out recovery_type = "FRAUD_SCREENING"
 # Get fraud screening data - using SID select from fraud_screening table
 # Check status of fraud screening request:
 ## Status "Sent" - start Fraud screening process from "Fraud screening result needed" (see second diagram) and update recovery status to "RFS_RESULT". Then end process.
 ## Status "In processing":
 ### Call API end point batch/\{signingBatchSID}/payment-count-by-status (created with SMARTPAY-717):
 #### All payments with status "Sent" - start fraud screening request sending process from "Fraud screening result needed" (see second diagram) and update recovery status to "RFS_RESULT". Then end process.
 #### All payments with final fraud screening status - update Fraud screening request status to "Completed" and update recovery status to "RFS_COMPLETED" and end process.
 ## Status "Completed" - update recovery status to "RFS_NOT_NEEDED" and end process.
 ## Status "Registered" / "In preparation" - start fraud screening request sending process from "Fraud screening request needed" (see second diagram) and update recovery status to "RFS_RESULT" and end process.

 

Also: update main process - if it was initiated from recovery, at the end of process update recovery status (see second diagram)

column1: [CORE DB] Provide TPH payment information in MT900/910
column47:
*Why:* SWIFT debit/credit notifications shall have also information on payments processed by TPH

*When:* Latest by TPH incoming payments go live

*Where:* Outgoing MT900/910 service (package: vv_sw_900_910)

*What:*  Following requirements apply for MT900/910 related to incoming/outgoing payments that are processed via TPH: 
||MT900/910 field||Mapping||
|*MT910 (Credit transactions)*| |
|Field 20: Transaction Reference Number|PAYMENTS.PAYMENT_REFERENCE.RELATED_SYSTEM_REFERENCE|
|Field 21: Related Reference|CREBIT.DP.END_TO_END_ID 
In case > 16x then first 16x are used|
|Field 52a: Ordering institution|In case of *pacs.009* (TPHFI, TPHFO, TPHFT):  CREBIT.DP.DEBTOR_NAME
*In case it contains valid BIC8 or BIC11 then option 52A
*Otherwise option 52D, as much as fits
In case of *other* messages (TPHCI, TPHCO, TPHCT): CREBIT.DP.DEBTOR_AGENT_SID→PAYMENTS.ISO_AGENT.SID→ NVL (BIC, NAME)
*In case of BIC then option 52A
*Otherwise option 52D, as much as fits|
|Field 56a: Intermediary|Do not add for TPH incoming payments|
|Field 72: Sender To Receiver Information|CREBIT.DP.UNSTRUCTURED_REMITTANCE_INFO|
|*MT900 (Debit transactions)*| |
|Field 20: Transaction Reference Number|PAYMENTS.PAYMENT_REFERENCE.RELATED_SYSTEM_REFERENCE |
|Field 21: Related Reference|NVL (CREBIT.DP.INSTRUCTION_ID, CREBIT.DP.ORIG_BANK_TXID)|
|Field 52a: Ordering institution|In case of *pacs.009* (TPHFI, TPHFO, TPHFT):  CREBIT.DP.DEBTOR_NAME
*In case it contains valid BIC8 or BIC11 then option 52A
*Otherwise option 52D, as much as fits
In case of *other* messages (TPHCI, TPHCO, TPHCT): CREBIT.DP.DEBTOR_AGENT_SID→PAYMENTS.ISO_AGENT.SID→ NVL (BIC, NAME)
*In case of BIC then option 52A
*Otherwise option 52D, as much as fits|
|Field 72: Sender To Receiver Information|CREBIT.DP.UNSTRUCTURED_REMITTANCE_INFO|

*Additional info:*
 * NB! No changes/impact to payments processed via FP or for other transactions. 
 * Additional info: [TPH payments on Customer Statement|https://wiki.swedbank.net/display/DPAY/TPH+payments+on+Customer+Statement#TPHpaymentsonCustomerStatement-ProvideTPHpaymentdatainMT900/910]
 * For TPH transactions, TRANSACTION.SYSTEM_REFERENCE = PAYMENTS.PAYMENT_REFERENCE.DP_ID

*Acceptance criteria*
 # Following transactions related to TPH payment appear correctly in MT910:
 ** Incoming pacs.009 (TPHFI, TPHFT) credited to loro account
 ** Incoming pacs.008 (TPHCI) credited to loro account
 ** Incoming pacs.004 (TPHFI, TPHCI) credited to loro account
 ** Outgoing pacs.008 (TPHCO) with cover credited to loro account
 ** Outgoing pacs.004 credited to loro account

 ** Incoming pacs.009 (TPHFI, TPHFT) debited from loro account
 ** Incoming pacs.008 (TPHCI) debited from loro account
 ** Incoming pacs.004 (TPHFI, TPHCI) debited from loro account

 

*Testing notes:*
 * MT910/900 messages are generated for few loro accounts (only in EE), together with transaction. 
 * For testing, make
 ** pacs.008/009/004 from/to loro account via TPH
 ** pacs.008/009/004 from/to loro account via FP (to verify that there is no impact to existing)

Scope:
 * All payment types from group account from smart form
 * European and International payment from group account
 * List payment execution from group account
 * Creating and later executing domestic and international defined payment from group account

In addition:
 * To check possibility to add payment initiation test from group account in STAR

 

Currently our test users does not have group accounts, need to investigate how they can be created, possible solutions:
 * Include creation in post-sync scripts where test users are created
 * Add creation in automated tests

Regarding group accounts functionality, consult with [~rasart] and [~mikke]

column1: [CORE DB] Provide TPH payment information in MT950
column47:
*Why:* SWIFT MT950 statements shall have information on payments processed by TPH

*When:* Latest by TPH incoming payments go live

*Where:* Send MT950 (package: VV_SW950_SEARCH)

*What:* Following requirements apply for presenting incoming/outgoing payments that are processed via TPH: 
||MT950 subfield||Mapping||
|Transaction Type (Subfield 6)|Always "NTRF" for TPH transactions|
|*Credit transactions:*| |
|Reference for the Account Owner (Field 61, subfield 7) 
("Their reference")|CREBIT.DP.END_TO_END_ID
In case length > 16x, then first 16x are used.|
|Reference of the Account Servicing Institution (Field 61, subfield 8) 
("Our reference")|PAYMENTS.PAYMENT_REFERENCE.RELATED_SYSTEM_REFERENCE|
|Supplementary details (Field 61, subfield 9) 
("Additional info")|{+}For pacs.009 (TPHFT, TPHFI){+}:  'B/O ' \|\| CREBIT.DP.DEBTOR_NAME (first 34x)
{+}For other transactions{+}: CREBIT.DP.UNSTRUCTURED_REMITTANCE_INFO|
|*Debit transactions:*| |
|Reference for the Account Owner (Field 61, subfield 7) 
("Their reference")|NVL (CREBIT.DP.INSTRUCTION_ID,CREBIT.DP.ORIGIN_BANK_TXID)|
|Reference of the Account Servicing Institution (Field 61, subfield 8) 
("Our reference")|PAYMENTS.PAYMENT_REFERENCE.RELATED_SYSTEM_REFERENCE|
|Supplementary details (Field 61, subfield 9) 
("Additional info")|not used|

 *Additional info:*
 * NB! No changes/impact to payments processed via FP or for other transactions. 
 * Additional info: [TPH payments on Customer Statement |https://wiki.swedbank.net/display/DPAY/TPH+payments+on+Customer+Statement#TPHpaymentsonCustomerStatement-ProvideTPHpaymentdatainMT950statement]
 * For TPH transactions, TRANSACTION.SYSTEM_REFERENCE = PAYMENTS.PAYMENT_REFERENCE.DP_ID
 * MT950 and MT910/900 references must match

 

*Acceptance criteria*

Following transactions related to TPH payment appear correctly in MT950:
 # Incoming pacs.009 (TPHFI, TPHFT) debited from loro account
 # Incoming pacs.008 (TPHCI) debited from loro account
 # Incoming pacs.009 (TPHFI, TPHFT) credited to loro account
 # Incoming pacs.008 (TPHCI) credited to loro account
 # Incoming pacs.004 (TPHFI, TPHCI) credited to loro account
 # Incoming pacs.004 (TPHFI, TPHCI) debited from loro account
 # Outgoing pacs.004 credited to loro account
 # Outgoing pacs.008 (TPHCO) with cover credited to loro account (for testing, need to manipulate data in DP as we don't send outgoings to TPH yet)

 

*Testing notes:*
 * MT950 statements are generated for loro accounts, during night. Sometimes MT950 message is not generated automatically because procedure is unable to fill transaction code; in such case check statement from manual processing in Forms ([MT950 - BPAY Runaway Train ART - Swedbank IT Wiki|https://wiki.swedbank.net/display/DPAY/MT950]). It is not expected MT950 to fall to manual processing because of TPH payment.
 * For testing, make
 ** pacs.008/009/004 from/to loro account via TPH
 ** pacs.008/009/004 from/to loro account via FP (to verify that there is no impact to existing)
 * Statement line example:
61:241128C70,00NTRFNOTPROVIDED//SWEE241218000E9Y
B/O LHVBEE22XXX
 **  "NTRF" - Transaction Type
 ** "NOTPROVIDED" -  Reference for the Account Owner
 **  "SWEE241218000E9Y" - Reference of the Account Servicing Institution
 **  "B/O LHVBEE22XXX" - Supplementary details

column1: Remove 15 000 EUR limit for SEPA SCT Inst
column47:
*Why:* 

1) According to [Instant Payments Regulation (IPR)|https://www.ecb.europa.eu/paym/integration/retail/instant_payments/html/instant_payments_regulation.en.html] and [2025 EPC Payment Scheme Rulebooks|https://www.europeanpaymentscouncil.eu/news-insights/news/revised-entry-force-dates-2025-epc-payment-scheme-rulebooks-and-version-10-epc], payment service providers (PSPs) must to offer for all private and corporate customers (payment service users - PSU) two new payment limits: instant payment daily limit and instant payment transaction limit.

2) New Instant Payments Regulation does not set any general maximum transaction level limits for instant credit transfers in euro. That reflects the co legislator’s position that there should be no ‘default’ transaction based limits (like the €100,000 limit in the current rulebook of the SCT Inst Scheme) set by PSPs specifically for instant credit transfers in euro. According to Article 5a(6), only PSUs can determine a maximum amount that can be transferred by means of instant credit transfers (either transaction based or daily limits, but not both).

*When:*
 * On agreed date after organizing communication about new instant payment daily/ transaction limits to customers;
 * At latest {color:#172b4d}5{color} of October 2025 when IPR comes into force; 
 * Launching of instant payments daily/ transaction limits to customers must be synchronized with removal of 15 000 EUR limit for SEPA SCT Inst.

*Where:* 
*What:* Remove 15 000 EUR limit for SEPA SCT Inst.

update crebit.sysglobal set p_sisu = '99999999', p_tyyp = '9999999999999.99' where p_nimi = 'RT1_LIMIT'

/

commit

/

 

*Possible impacts (changes could impact other applications/ processes etc.):* Check with Open banking representatives if this limitation should not be removed on their side.
*Acceptance criteria/ testing notes:*
 * It will be needed extensive testing in all channels where instant payments are allowed: iBank Private, iBank Business, Mobile app, Open banking.
 ** Should be checked regarding *PIA* and {*}Round Up{*}.
 ** *Channels STAR, SGW, Banklink* are not in scope as so far there was not implemented instant payments.
 * Testing could be organized at the same time with new instant payments daily/ transaction limits implementation (see VDE19-150 [IPR] Enabler: analyze new requirements for Instant Payments limits - Swedbank).

column1: Create API to update batch and file status
column47:
*Why:* Once pain.002 report is sent, batch and payment statuses have to reflect that
*When:* 
*Where:* core-payment-batch-handler-data-manager 
*What:*

Provide application, which is calling API in the header. Use it when storing/updating data to database as "created by" / "last modified by" value.

API structure:
 * payment file SID

API actions:
 # Collect all batches in the file. For each batch:
 ## Check status of all payments in the batch:
 ### If there exists at least one payment with status "P_REGISTERED" - provide error as API response
 ### If there exists at least one payment with status "P_PROCESSING" - update batch status to "B_PROCESSING"
 ### If status of all payments is "P_REJECTED" and reporting status either "PR_NOT_NEEDED" or "PR_REPORTED" - update batch status to "B_REJECTED"
 ### If status of all payments is "P_COMPLETED" and reporting status either "PR_NOT_NEEDED" or "PR_REPORTED" - update batch status to "B_COMPLETED"
 ### For all other cases - do nothing
 ## Check status of all batches in the file:
 ### If there exists at least one batch with status is "B_PROCESSING" - update file status to "PF_PROCESSING"
 ### If status of all batches is "B_REJECTED" - update file status to "PF_REJECTED"
 ### If status of all batches is "B_COMPLETED" - update file status to "PF_COMPLETED"
 ### If status of all batches is "B_COMPLETED" and "B_REJECTED" - update file status to "PF_COMPLETED"

Before trying to update batch or payment file status check the status - do not update if it's already correct.

 

Result:
 - Success
 - Failure

 

For possibility of effective problems investigation, API activity logging should comply with requirements: [https://wiki.swedbank.net/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=1878516655#CorrespondentAccountsAPIAD(DRAFT)-2.1.6Functionallogging]

It should be possible to relate request and response log records - using trace_id or another special parameter. Example: PAYME-963

column1: [DB] SOP created with wrong conditions (LV only)
column47:
*Issue:* In LV e-invoice seller (agreement) can own 2 service_id-s:  Service_id and service_id2.

According to that e-invoice SOA ( standing order agreement) is created also with 2 service_id-s.

According to this logic e-invoice automatic payment  (SOP) has to create only in case when both service_id-s match together , I mean :

einvoices.einvoice.service_id=einvoices.payment_agreement.service_id

and 

einvoices.einvoice.service_id2=einvoices.payment_agreement.service_id2.

Currently SOP creation doesn't work this way because of [https://git.swedbank.net/projects/DB-CORE/repos/einvoices/diff/src/batchLV.pkb?until=0b29ec7a4b353cdb229b23dc06afecf4ae444d55]

result: SOP is created when only service_id match.

In LV we have currently 6 cases:

select e.service_id,a.service_id,e.service_id2,a.service_id2, e.*,a.* from EINVOICES.EINVOICE E ,einvoices.Payment_Agreement a where
e.payment_agreement_id=a.id and
E.SERVICE_ID2<>A.SERVICE_ID2

 

*Preconditions:*  buyer 551029914066, AUTO 26 SIA, seller SWEDBANK LĪZINGS SIA.

einvoice_id 45559851,46059223

 

*Steps to reproduce:*

*Expected results:*
E-incoice SOP is created only when both service_id-s are exactly the same.

*Actual results:* 
E-invoice SOP is created wrongly and money will be automatically debited for wrong e-invoice

*Root cause (if known): https://jira.swedbank.net/browse/EASYPAY-805*

*Workaround (if exists): not exists*

*Impact:*
 LV
<Number of users impacted (if known)> currently 6 
<Private/Corporate customers?> both

*Additional information:* 
INC07517585

Ibank -> Smart form -> Make payment with amount more than 10 millions to Instant reachable bank

Payment is sent as Instant

*Actual results:* 
Payment gets stuck with RTGS out channel and SPX holder channel

*Workaround (if exists):*

Update payment priority to U, remove holder channel code and push payment via EPE Web

PB

In addition need to test same case, but with SEPA payment. Expected result should be that SEPA payment is converted to RTGS and sent out

*Why:* SEPA rulebook changes.
*When:* After changes in _hard deadline_ mechanism.
*Where:* sepa-exchange app
*What:* 

Currently, our system sends status update messages for Instant Payment transactions that have not received a response from the beneficiary bank. The SEPA exchange initiates five inquiries for each message if an accept or reject response has not been received. These inquiries are sent at the following time intervals: 60 seconds, 600 seconds, 1800 seconds, and 3600 seconds.

This functionality will be decommissioned as we introduce an automated cancellation process through the new hard deadline mechanism.

 * New sysglobal_value added in system to control additional logging
 * Enable logging for payment processing applications to store info in logs about DB access during each step

{*}+NOTE+{*}: Additional logging is not meant to be used in production only in Pre-production environments for Performance test needs.

column1: Create scheduler to find entries in need of recovery for worker
column47:
*Why:* In case application crashes, on start-up it should check if there are any entries with status indicating that their processing was not finished. Those entries should be published to Kafka recovery topic to start recovery process.
*When:* 
*Where:* core-payment-batch-handler-data-manager
*What:* 

End point incoming parameters:
 * none

End point actions:
 * Find records in Payment_file table with status PF_REGISTERED, PF_VALIDATED and last modified dtime < current time + 15 min. If any found - - publish that Payment file SID to Kafka topic w990.batch.handler.recovery.requests with type PAYMENT_FILE
 * Find records in Status_report table with status SR_REGISTERED, SR_IN_PREPARATION and last modified dtime < current time + 15 min. If any found - - publish that Status report SID to Kafka topic w990.batch.handler.recovery.requests with type STATUS_REPORT
 * Find records in Fraud_screening table with status FS_REGISTERED, FS_IN_PREPARATION. FS_PROCESSING and last modified dtime < current time + 15 min. If any found - - publish that Fraud screening SID to Kafka topic w990.batch.handler.recovery.requests with type FRAUD_SCREENING
 * Find records in Payment_file table with status PF_IN_PROCESSING and last modified dtime < current time + 15 min. Then for each payment file:
 ** select all records from Batch table by Payment_file_SID, and select all payments from payments table by batch SID:
 *** If all payments in all batches have final status and their reporting status is PR_NOT_NEEDED - publish that Payment file SID to Kafka topic w990.batch.handler.recovery.requests with type PAYMENT_FILE.
 *** If all payments in all batches have final status and their reporting status is PR_REPORTED, select entries from status_report table by batch sid (all batches), if all of them have status SR_SENT - publish Payment file SID to Kafka topic w990.batch.handler.recovery.requests with type PAYMENT_FILE. Otherwise do nothing with the payment file

column1: EKS pacs.004 changes
column47:
*Why:* The EKS 2025 October release includes the following changes:
 * "Original ID" format alignment to the version 2019 of the XML schemas.
 * "Original Message Name ID" enhancement to accommodate every possible future ISO20022 version change.
 * Hybrid postal address usage is introduced.

*When:* Rulebook changes come to force on sysglobal SEPA_RB_2025_START date. Changes can be applied without checking sysglobal.

*Where:* EKS pacs.004 - Payment return message

*What:*
{panel}
pacs.004 | Document/PmtRtr/TxInf/OrgnlGrpInf/
 * {*}OrgnlMsgId{*}: Format pattern change to ([0-9a-zA-Z\-\?:\(\)\.,'\+](/?([0-9a-zA-Z\-\?:\(\)\.,'\+ ]/?)*[0-9a-zA-Z\-\?:\(\)\.,'\+]+)?)
 * {*}OrgnlMsgNmId{*}: With the new pattern, only the presence of the message type is mandatory and validated (e.g.: ‘pacs.008’). The full message name, including variant and version (e.g. ‘pacs.008.001.08’), will still be supported by schema but not validated.

pacs.004 | Document/PmtRtr/TxInf/
 * *OrgnlInstrId* and {*}OrgnlTxId{*}: Format pattern change to ([0-9a-zA-Z\-\?:\(\)\.,'\+](/?([0-9a-zA-Z\-\?:\(\)\.,'\+ ]/?)*[0-9a-zA-Z\-\?:\(\)\.,'\+]+)?)

pacs.004 | Document/PmtRtr/TxInf/OrgnlTxRef/
 * *Cdtr/Pty/PstlAdr* and {*}Dbtr/Pty/PstlAdr{*}: Possibility to use hybrid postal address is added. It will be possible to use fully structured (as now), unstructured (as now), or a mix of structured and unstructured data elements (new). Hybrid address has at least elements ‘Town Name’, ‘Country Code, 'Address Line'.{panel}
 
 # Updated pacs.004 XSD is used.
 # Outgoing pacs.004:
 ** OrgnlMsgId, OrgnlInstrId, OrgnlTxId: New format pattern is used.
 ** OrgnlMsgNmId: Original message name is used (can be either full name or short name).
 ** PstlAdr: Creditor, Debtor structured/unstructured/hybrid address (if provided) is included into outgoing message.
 # Incoming pacs.004:
 ** OrgnlMsgId, OrgnlInstrId, OrgnlTxId: New format pattern is used.
 ** OrgnlMsgNmId: System is able to handle messages with full name and with short name.
 ** PstlAdr: Creditor, Debtor structured/unstructured/hybrid address (if provided) is stored in PAYMENTS.ISO_POST_ADDRESS table.

 
*Notes:*
* "Original ID" - Verify with regression tests that only new pattern is used.
* Sepa-exchange does not support separate XSDs for outgoing and incoming messages.

column1: [SEPA_EXCHANGE] Incoming/outgoing pacs.008 message storing in new Party ID structure
column47:
*Why:* 

RT1/STEP2 2025 October release includes the following change:
 * “Debtor Organisation ID” and “Ultimate Debtor Organisation ID” will be enhanced allowing ‘AnyBIC’, ‘LEI’ and ‘Other’ to be used together. Each of the 3 data elements shall not be used more than once. The change does not affect the Creditor/ Ultimate Creditor ID.

*When:* From sysglobal SEPA_RB_2025_START date.

*Where:* SEPA EXCHANGE.   

*What:*  
 # Outgoing pacs.008: 
 ** Debtor, Creditor, Ultimate Debtor, Ultimate Creditor:
 *** Organization/Private IDs are fetched either from OLD or from NEW data model. 
 # Incoming pacs.008: 
 ** Debtor, Creditor, Ultimate Debtor, Ultimate Creditor:
 *** Organization/Private IDs are stored according to new data model.
 *** {*}Debtor, Ultimate Debtor Organization ID{*}s: If multiple IDs are provided, then all are saved. 

*Notes:*
 * For new data model, see [Party identification mapping & examples|https://wiki.swedbank.net/spaces/DPAY/pages/2273426761/Party+Identification].

column1: Change time for sending 1st. status request inquiry message pacs.028
column47:
*Why:* SEPA rulebook 2025 changes.
*When:* From sysglobal SEPA_RB_2025_START date.
*Where:* SEPA-exchange
*What:* 

Currently if the acceptance or rejection messages are not received, five INQUIRY (status request) messages are sent within the following time intervals: 60, 600, 1800, 3600 sec. With Rulebook implementation 1st. status request inquiry message must be sent after 9 seconds with interval:  9, 600, 1800, 3600 sec.

Set-up in Sepa-exchange:

##################inquiry ##################
inquiry.attempt.delays.seconds=60,600,1800,3600
inquiry.attempt.count=5

*Translation labels (if any):* NA
*Possible impacts (changes could impact other applications/ processes etc.):* NE

column1: [DB] Create return payment (ID)
column47:
*Why:* Identifications of Debtor (Remitter), Creditor (Beneficiary) will be saved per new data model to support multiple IDs according to business rules.
*When:* From sysglobal SEPA_RB_2025_START date.
*Where:* DB procedure
*What:* When (a) user returns payment using Forms Teller SEPA return incoming payment form or (b) payment is returned automatically, then:
* When creating outgoing return payment that is saved into DP: ID data is stored per new data model. Applies also when incoming payment has IDs stored per old data model.
* If multiple Debtor/Ultimate Debtor Organization IDs were received with incoming payment, then all of them are returned.

 Comments:
 # See new data model [mapping and examples|https://wiki.swedbank.net/spaces/DPAY/pages/2273426761/Party+Identification]

*Why:* To test Rulebook changes for STEP2 Q4 2025 release

*When:* 
 * User Acceptance Test starts >> *08 July 2025*
 * User Acceptance Test ends >> *19 September 2025*

*Where:* Estonia (HABAEE2X)

*What:* Pass mandatory test cases provided by EBA STEP2 (attached in feature level). 

*Testing notes:*
 * Intragroup (SEPGO/SEPGI) payments are not suitable for this test as these are not sent through STEP2
 * Outgoing:  Send SEPCO and/or SEPO payments; manual message upload is ok if needed (for example to add multiple ID's to message). 
 * Incoming: Manual upload is not ok, message must be received from STEP2. Agree with 3rd banks or use EBA SATP tool to initiate incoming payments. 
 * Be aware that STEP2 day is shortened in Pilot environment (times in CET below) so to send something to same day processing, you need to do before 13:45 (Baltic time)

column47:
*Why:* To test Rulebook changes for STEP2 Q4 2025 release

*When:* 
 * User Acceptance Test starts >> *08 July 2025*
 * User Acceptance Test ends >> *19 September 2025*

*Where:* Latvia (HABALV22)

*What:* Pass mandatory test cases provided by EBA STEP2 (attached in feature level). 

*Testing notes:*
 * Intragroup (SEPGO/SEPGI) payments are not suitable for this test as these are not sent through STEP2
 * Outgoing:  Send SEPCO and/or SEPO payments; manual message upload is ok if needed (for example to add multiple ID's to message). 
 * Incoming: Manual upload is not ok, message must be received from STEP2. Agree with 3rd banks or use EBA SATP tool to initiate incoming payments. 
 * Be aware that STEP2 day is shortened in Pilot environment (times in CET below) so to send something to same day processing, you need to do before 13:45 (Baltic time)

column47:

 * User Acceptance Test starts >> *14 July 2025* (for TIPS 28 July 2025 as of 11h)

*Testing notes:*
 * Outgoing:  Send SIPCO and/or SIPO payments; manual message upload is not preferred but OK if needed (for example to add multiple ID's to message).

Can we still consider such test cases as passed? We will of course be able to handle both, short and long messages on incoming leg._

column47:
*Precondition:*
 * Some pacs.008 and pacs.004 are sent and received during LAC. 
 * RT1_LAC_COUNT is updated to 10 (EASYPAY-1127)

*What:*
 # PSR and RSF files are received and processed successfully for all 10 LAC cycles
 # The PSR reports
 ** outgoing pacs.008 settled in FS001 to FS009 and outgoing pacs.004 settled in FS011 on debit side for that LAC 
 ** incoming pacs.008 settled in FS001 to FS009 and incoming pacs.004 settled in FS011on credit side for that LAC 
 # {color:#de350b}The RSF reports the pacs.008 from FS001 to FS009 and the pacs.004 from FS011 that were processed during that LAC{color} 

*Testing notes:*
 * LAC timings can be found from Test scripts attached to feature (tab 'Information'; times are in CET). The change with this Rulebook is that instead of 8 LAC's there will be 10 LAC's so PSR and RSF files should be received 10 times per day. 
 * RT1 PWS can be consulted to see which files and when have been issued by RT1 (List files > List files). These all should appear in our DB after processing by RT1-uploader (PB):
 ** select * from sepa.rsf_file_rt1
 ** select * from sepa.psr_file_rt1
 * Processed PSR details are also available in Forms > Operations > Domestic payments > Reconciliation > IP Reconciliation reports (Report tab)
 ** sum of outgoing settled payments: 
 *** Payments sent LQPS (SEPA.LIQUIDITY_POSITION_RT1.AMOUNT_SENT) + 
 *** Payments sent RT1A (SEPA.LIQUIDITY_POSITION_RT1.AMOUNT_SENT_RT1A)
 ** sum if incoming settled payments:
 *** Payments received LQPS (SEPA.LIQUIDITY_POSITION_RT1.AMOUNT_RECEIVED) +
 *** Payments received RT1A (SEPA.LIQUIDITY_POSITION_RT1.AMOUNT_RECEIVED_RT1A)
 * RSF details can be found in DB tables
 ** SEPA.RSF_FILE_RT1
 ** SEPA.RSF_TRANSACTION_STATUS_RT1

*NB! I would expect that this test case is updated in next version of test scripts. Please check before executing.* 

From Q&A with EBA:

_4. RR001 - Expected result for RSF seems wrong._
_Test case describes expected result as "the RSF reports the pacs.008 settled in FS001 to FS009 on debit side and the PRR pacs.004 settled in FS011 on credit side for that LAC for PSP A"._
_Could you please clarify what is actual expected result for RSF report as current description seems invalid (RSF does not report debits and credits but payment statuses)?_

_Answer: In general we have adapted test scripts from last year and made some changes. So basically we may have been referring to test cases that were not valid for this year. The aim of this test is to ensure that all relevant transactions are present in the RSF. So please test with that._

*What:* Pass mandatory test cases provided by EBA RT1 (attached in feature level). 

*Testing notes:*
 * Outgoing:  Send SIPCO and/or SIPO payments; manual message upload is not preferred but OK if needed (for example to add multiple ID's to message). 
 * Incoming: Manual upload is not ok, message must be received via RT1. Agree with test partners or use EBA SATP tool to initiate incoming payments. 
 * To verify that RT1 position was updated, you can check from RT1 PWS before and after making a payment (Liquidity management > Monitoring liquidity > Current Net position). Alternatively, it is also enough to verify that amount is included in PSR settled amount for same LAC (EASYPAY-1141)

_1. Test cases related to Original Message Name ID expect participant to send pacs.002 with OrgnlMsgNmId "pacs.008"._
_As both, short and full version will be allowed then we have decided to keep full message name (e.g. "pacs.008.001.08") and therefore cannot follow test script from that angle. Can we still consider such test cases as passed? We will of course be able to handle both, short and long messages on incoming leg._

_Answer: Yes you can consider this as passed. The important thing is that you are able to handle short and long format on the incoming leg._

column1: [LV] Execute mandatory testcases for RT1 Q4 2025
column47:
*Why:* To test Rulebook changes for RT1 Q4 2025 release

*When:* 
 * User Acceptance Test starts >> *14 July 2025* (for TIPS 28 July 2025 as of 11h)
 * User Acceptance Test ends >> *19 September 2025*

*Where:* Latvia (HABALV22)

*What:* Pass mandatory test cases provided by EBA RT1 (attached in feature level). 

*Testing notes:*
 * Outgoing:  Send SIPCO and/or SIPO payments; manual message upload is not preferred but OK if needed (for example to add multiple ID's to message). 
 * Incoming: Manual upload is not ok, message must be received via RT1. Agree with test partners or use EBA SATP tool to initiate incoming payments. 
 * To verify that RT1 position was updated, you can check from RT1 PWS before and after making a payment (Liquidity management > Monitoring liquidity > Current Net position). Alternatively, it is also enough to verify that amount is included in PSR settled amount for same LAC (EASYPAY-1158)
 * Our Q&A with EBA about test cases that require short OrgnlMsgNmId to be used:

_1. Test cases related to Original Message Name ID expect participant to send pacs.002 with OrgnlMsgNmId "pacs.008"._
_As both, short and full version will be allowed then we have decided to keep full message name (e.g. "pacs.008.001.08") and therefore cannot follow test script from that angle. Can we still consider such test cases as passed? We will of course be able to handle both, short and long messages on incoming leg._

_Answer: Yes you can consider this as passed. The important thing is that you are able to handle short and long format on the incoming leg._

_2. FS008, FS009 test cases expect that payments with structured postal address are sent._
_Is it also acceptable to send hybrid address instead of structured as hybrid address is the actual change that is introduced with upcoming Rulebook?_
 - _Hybrid address: Town name + Country + Address Line + optionally other fields_
 - _Structured address: Town name + Country + optionally other fields; Address Line is not allowed_

_Answer: Yes you can send hybrid. Just ensure that on the incoming leg you can accept Unstructured, Structured and Hybrid._

*What:*

 * RT1 PWS can be consulted to see which files and when have been issued by RT1 (List files > List files). These all should appear in our DB after processing by RT1-uploader (PB):
 ** select * from sepa.rsf_file_rt1
 ** select * from sepa.psr_file_rt1
 * Processed PSR details are also available in Forms > Operations > Domestic payments > Reconciliation > IP Reconciliation reports (Report tab)

_Answer: In general we have adapted test scripts from last year and made some changes. So basically we may have been referring to test cases that were not valid for this year. The aim of this test is to ensure that all relevant transactions are present in the RSF. So please test with that._

column1: [payment-services] Improve PaymentPriorityOutChannelCode RPC endpoint to set the priority as normal for future dated instant payments
column47:
*Why:* If the client has selected the payment priority as “Instant” and the payment date is in the future (i.e., later than today), then the payment priority should be changed to “Normal”.
*When:* When request is sent from Flow Manager (FLM)
*Where:* Payment services
*What:* 
 * Improve PaymentPriorityOutChannelCode RPC to set normal priority when the the payment has instant priority and date is > today
 * Add reqdExctnDt attribute to the request

*RPC description and mapping requirement provided here:* [Payment Services: FLM supporting Service endpoints|https://wiki.swedbank.net/spaces/DPAY/pages/2250138228/Payment+Services+FLM+supporting+Service+endpoints]

{*}PODM JSON structure and mappings{*}{*}:{*} *[Payment Order Data Manager JSON structure.xlsx|https://myntet.sharepoint.com/:x:/r/teams/PaymentsBaltic/Delade%20dokument/Analysis%20and%20architecture/Payments%20Mapping%20to%20ISO%20Elements/Payment%20Order%20Data%20Manager%20JSON%20structure.xlsx?d=w6c9d1db06f5e470ebd740697eb46ab2f&csf=1&web=1&e=ZbXcJe]*
h3. Acceptance Criteria

*AC1: Adjustment of Payment Priority for Future-Dated Instant Payments*
*GIVEN* a payment request where the client has selected the payment priority as “Instant” for single or mass payment
*AND* the payment date is in the future (i.e., later than today)
*WHEN* the RPC processes the payment
*THEN* the payment priority is automatically changed to “Normal”
*AND* payment is not rejected

*AC2: Addition of Execution and Settlement Date Attributes to RPC request*
*GIVEN* a payment request is being constructed
*WHEN* the request is prepared for submission to the system
*AND* it could include the attribute {{reqdExctnDt}} (Requested Execution Date)
AND it can be in the future
AND priority is set as INSTANT
*THEN* the payment is not rejected
AND is automatically changed to Normal priority

 

+*Note:*+ that same validation will be required for imported payments in iBank (requirements will be described under [https://jira.swedbank.net/browse/PAYRUN-2776] ). According when implementing could consider that EPE could call same check.

column1: Implement status report recovery process
column47:
*Why:* if status response creation failed, status response recovery process needs to check at which step status response creation failed and then proceed accordingly 
*When:* 
*Where:* worker-payment-batch-handler
*What:*

As this is recovery process - it has to reuse as many elements of original process, so that no action would be duplicated in the application (easier maintenance later).

 

Process:
 # Read Kafka topic (created with SMARTPAY-850), filter out recovery_type = "STATUS_REPORT"
 # Call API end point status-report/\{SID} (created with PAYRUN-2845)
 # Check status of status report:
 ## Status "Sent" - call API (created with SMARTPAY-867) to update recovery status to "RSR_NOT_NEEDED" and end process.
 ## Status "In preparation":
 ### Check if filebarn ID is already stored (from status_report data):
 #### if it is, start main process from "Send status report" (see second diagram) and call API (created with SMARTPAY-867) to update recovery status to "RSR_INITIATED". Then end process.
 #### If it is not - start status report process from "Status report needed" (see second diagram) and call API (created with SMARTPAY-867) to update recovery status to "RSR_INITIATED". Then end process.
 ## Status "Registered":
 ### Start status report process from "Status report needed" (see second diagram) and call API (created with SMARTPAY-867) to update recovery status to "RSR_INITIATED". Then end process.

 

Also:

update main process - if it was initiated from recovery, at the end of process update recovery status (see second diagram)

column1: iBank Private and Business PB: Enable regular and urgent payments in SMART payment form in case customer has disabled or already exceeded instant payments limit

 * Instant payment daily limit.
 * Instant payment transaction limit.

*When:* On agreed date after organizing communication to customers; at latest {color:#172b4d}5{color} of October 2025.
*Where:* In iBank Private and Business -> Daily banking -> New payment -> tab "Domestic or European", SMART payment form

*What:* 

*{color:#172b4d}Pre-conditions:{color}*

 * {color:#172b4d}Permanent Teleagreement daily and/ or monthly payment limit is NOT exceeded yet.{color}{color:#172b4d} {color}

{color:#172b4d}1. After customer enters amount in SMART payment form, then:{color}

{color:#172b4d}1) It should be automatically hidden value "Instant" in field Payment priority AND {color}{color:#172b4d}showed two options: {color}
 * {color:#172b4d}EE, LT: "Ordinary"/LV: "Economy" and {color}
 * {color:#172b4d}"Urgent"/ "Express"{color}{color:#172b4d}; {color}

{color:#172b4d}3) Buy default it should be checked Payment priority: EE, LT: "Ordinary"/LV: "Economy";{color}

{color:#172b4d}4) According to customer choice it must be allowed to initiate payment with payment type "Normal" or "Urgent" (?) {color}(CREBIT.DP.DOC_PRIORITY='N' OR 'U' (?)).

2. In case it was exceeded instant payment limit, in SMART payment form it must be showed 2 warning messages as described:

1) PAYRUN-2273 iBank Private and Business PB: Showing warning message in case customer tries to make instant payment and instant payment daily/ transaction limit is exceeded - Swedbank

2) PAYRUN-2274 iBank Private and Business PB: Showing permanent warning message how customer can increase instant payment limit - Swedbank.

3. In case customer has disabled instant payments, then it must be showed 2 warning messages:

2) PAYRUN-2274 iBank Private and Business PB: Showing permanent warning message how customer can increase instant payment limit - Swedbank.

column1: Foreign payment executed in another currency, limits are used twice
column47:
In private/business ibank.

Foreign payment executed (manual or from list of payments) in another currency, limits are used twice



I think it is because:

[https://git.swedbank.net/projects/CHANNELS/repos/bank-components/browse/src/ee/hansa/bank/payments/…|https://git.swedbank.net/projects/CHANNELS/repos/bank-components/browse/src/ee/hansa/bank/payments/CorporateForeignPaymentComponentImpl.java?at=refs%2Fheads%2Frelease%2F6.7#698-723]

Here is called procedure *thn.thn_vmk.accept_do_forpm* for execution and right after that *permissionsComponent.useLimits*

Problem is that *thn.thn_vmk.accept_do_forpm* already uses limits
Call: [https://git.swedbank.net/projects/DB-CORE/repos/thn/browse/src/thn_vmkEE.pkb#1293-1313]

Usage is here: [https://git.swedbank.net/projects/DB-CORE/repos/payments/browse/src/fpo_payment.pkb#1400-1421,1814-1835]
 * oper_permistted - check
 * oper_performed - use limits

This is current production code

 

 

Comment from Aleksejs Gapčenko:
Regarding "limits are used twice". Let's remove second using. Seems it was bug-on-bug and somehow it worked normally. Now we changes limit usage logic and got old bug.


Has impact on PBREL282

Also it was noticed that there is a difference between limit used by db procedure thn.thn_vmk.accept_do_forpm and application. DB procedure  converts payment amount by transfer rate, not by official.

column1: iBank Private and Business PB: Re-factor error and warning messages UI presentment in SMART payment form
column47:
*Why:*
 * According to [Instant Payments Regulation|https://www.ecb.europa.eu/paym/integration/retail/instant_payments/html/instant_payments_regulation.en.html] and [2025 EPC Payment Scheme Rulebooks,|https://www.europeanpaymentscouncil.eu/news-insights/news/revised-entry-force-dates-2025-epc-payment-scheme-rulebooks-and-version-10-epc] it was implemented two new payment limits: Instant payment daily limit  and Instant payment transaction limit with possibility for customer to disable instant payments at all. Together with introduction of new limits it was revised and provided recommendations for error and warning messages presentment UI in SMART payment form by UX expert.
 * According to requirements coming from Accessibility, also based on fact that many customers use SMART payment form in mobile, presentment of warning messages on top of form creates risk that it will not be noticed by customer and/or confuse and force customer to scroll above to see what is wrong.

*When:*  It was agreed that this task can be implemented after IPR Go Live after {color:#172b4d}5th{color} of October 2025.
*Where:* In iBank Private and Business -> Daily banking -> New payment -> tab: "Domestic or European", SMART payment form
*What:* 

1. It should be removed all error, warning and info messages presentment from the top of the payment form and info, warning and error messages should be showed on the bottom of the form above Service fee section. TO BE exemplary screens for error and warning messages UI presentment see in UC2-UC7 in [Use cases - customer has disabled instant payments/ exceeded IP limits - Payments Baltics VDE - Swedbank IT Wiki:|https://wiki.swedbank.net/spaces/DPAY/pages/2419818556/Use+cases+-+customer+has+disabled+instant+payments+exceeded+IP+limits]
 * UC2-UC3: warning and info messages presentment on bottom of the page.
 * UC4-UC7: error message presentment on bottom of the page.

2. All error, warning and info messages should be presented *above* Service fee field as presented in screen:

Note: Successful payment messages should be left on top of the page as after payment initiation payment form reloads and customer starts reading screen again from the top:

*Why:* Response to fraud screening request will be received via API call. It is needed to calculate when to call response API
*When:*

*What:*

Update timeout calculation for the fraud screening request update API endpoint:  fraud-screening-request/update

 

API endpoint actions:
 * store data provided
 * do not allow to overwrite response_type, transaction_id - if they were already stored, API response should be failure
 * {color:#ff8b00}if request_sent_dtime is provided, calculate response_timeout_dtime and store it. Calculation:  request_sent_dtime + time from table{color}
 * {color:#ff8b00}validate that response_type is either "TIMEOUT" or "KAFKA_MSG" (other values not allowed){color}

{color:#ff8b00}Table for timeouts:{color}
||Amount of payments||Minutes for timeout||
|<1000|2|
|1000 - 9999|3|
|>= 10 000|5|

column1: Enhance GRPC ExecuteSaved for batch processing
column47:
*Why:* Increase stability and performance for executing batch payments where debiting is from the same account. Account is being locked for every payment and therefore limits execution. There are many retries and errors because of this locking and many payments waiting for account to be unlocked.
*When:* During request to GRPC service request ExecuteSaved
*Where:* GRPC service request ExecuteSaved
*What:* Enhance the ExecuteSaved endpoint to do internal "routing" for processing. There are two possible scenarios:
1. FPO payments to leave for FPO Debit batch for processing, to reach this goal Payment holder channel must be updated to *FPOB* (payments would be processes in ~each 10 min)

2. All non-FPO payments to be inserted in AQ where there currently is functionality of reading, grouping by account and processing in 5sec intervals. With one account lock multiple debiting operations are executed, overall throughput will increase.

Request parameters do not change, each payment execution is requested separately by sending DP.ID in the request. 
Response will not contain only information that payment is accepted. Actual processing values to be changed in DP table and flow manager will receive changes with DB trigger.

*Possible impacts (changes could impact other applications/ processes etc.):* How to handle instant payments in batches - timestamp is planned to be set in Flow Manager. But if process takes place every 5 seconds then timestamp should be set on execution side (how this is from compliance perspective?)

*Acceptance criteria/ testing notes:*
7000 payments per minute accepted by ExecuteSaved endpoint. All requested payments in DP table status value should be changed to D,C,N within the minute from the first request.

column1: [iBank Private and Business PB]: Do not initiate VoP check again in case beneficiary's data is not changed in Standing Order Agreement conclusion
column47:
*Why:* 

1. According to [Instant Payments Regulation|https://www.ecb.europa.eu/paym/integration/retail/instant_payments/html/instant_payments_regulation.en.html] Article 5c, 1-6 points: 

_1. A payer’s PSP shall offer the payer a service ensuring verification of the payee to whom the payer intends to send a credit transfer (service ensuring verification). The payer’s PSP shall perform the service ensuring verification immediately after the payer provides relevant information about the payee and before the payer is offered the possibility of authorising that credit transfer. The payer’s PSP shall offer the service ensuring verification regardless of the payment initiation channel used by the payer to place a payment order for the credit transfer._

2. According to received clarification from PB lawyers, for Domestic and European Standing Order Agreements (SOA) it is needed to run Verification of Payee (VoP) only before agreement signing and it is valid for the whole period of SOA. This is due to the fact that IPR states VOP results need to be seen by user, and if SO payments are running automatically then there is no user whom to show this VoP response. 

3. SOAs in iBank have only two processes: conclusion and termination, no possibility to change agreements, therefore VoP check must be initiated for SOA conclusion only.

*When:* at latest 9 of October 2025.

*Where:* PB iBank Private and Business → Everyday Banking →Payments -> Standing Orders

*What:* 

*Pre-condition:* VoP check was already initiated, VoP response (NMTC/ CMTC/ NOAP) presented and in opened dialog box customer has pressed button "Back".

-If after presenting VoP result and returning back to 1st step of Standing Order Agreement conclusion form "Fill application", customer does not change any Beneficiary name and Beneficiary account data in the same agreement and again presses button "Confirm", then VoP should NOT be initiated once again, i.e. it should be presented previously initiated VoP result.-
 * -*Exceptions:* In case it is received error message HTTP 4xx/5xx (Verification Check is not possible due temporary technical issues), Not received response during 5 seconds, Response is received after the reply to the Requester has been provided, then VoP check should be initiated.-

3. SOAs in iBank have only two processes: conclusion and termination. No possibility to change agreements.

*When:* can be implemented after IPR deadline 9th of October 2025.

*Where:* PB iBank Private and Business → Everyday Banking →Payments -> Standing Orders

*What:* 

-*VoP Use case is here: [Use Case - VoP in iBank Standing Order Agreement - Payments Baltics VDE - Swedbank IT Wiki|https://wiki.swedbank.net/spaces/DPAY/pages/2380317325/Use+Case+-+VoP+in+iBank+Standing+Order+Agreement]*-

-*Note:* This Attempt cap should be reset after successful signing of the payment or log out of the iBank (set as on iBank level NOT form level), going to different form should not reset the counter.- 

*Warning messages UI presentment:* described under scenario #8 in wiki page: [https://wiki.swedbank.net/spaces/DPAY/pages/2359416765/VoP+check+in+Standing+Order+Agreements#VoPcheckinStandingOrderAgreements-ASISandTOBEVoPcheckinSOAconclusioniniBank] 

*Translation labels:* *[Label update for VOP_for translations.xls|https://myntet.sharepoint.com/:x:/r/teams/InstantPaymentRegulation/_layouts/15/Doc.aspx?sourcedoc=%7BB8059B55-D72B-414E-8ECF-112D5D7DCD77%7D&file=Label%20update%20for%20VOP_for%20translations.xlsx&action=default&mobileredirect=true]*
h3. *Acceptance Criteria:*
h3. *AC1 – VoP call is allowed (Step 6, before 10a/10b conditions are met)*

*GIVEN* the customer is concluding a non-intrabank standing order agreement
*AND* the VoP request counter is below 100
*WHEN* the system evaluates whether to initiate a VoP call
*THEN* the system proceeds with the VoP service call
*AND* the VoP request counter is incremented
*AND* the request is forwarded to the VoP Request Processor API
h3. *AC2 – VoP counter exceeded (Step 6a, triggered by Step 10a after retry)*

*GIVEN* the customer previously encountered a VoP mismatch
*AND* chose to go back to Step 2a and edited the beneficiary name or IBAN
*AND* the VoP request counter has reached or exceeded 100 in the client session
*WHEN* the system attempts to initiate a new VoP call
*THEN* the system does not initiate the VoP service call
*AND* the flow continues to SOA conclusion with agreement terms and conditions
